case_number: 2024 INSC 206; CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS.___________OF 2024 [Arising out of Special Leave Petition (Criminal) No.12390-12391 of 2022]
summary: Quashing of criminal complaints under Negotiable Instruments Act; directors' liability standard requires personal supervision of business functions; mere designation as director insufficient; appellant's non-involvement in day-to-day operations and non-signatory status established; precedent reviewed including N.K. Wahi, S.M.S. Pharmaceuticals; High Court error in rejecting quash petition.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Haryana vs. Brij Lal Mittal
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; criminal complaints against appellant quashed; High Court judgment set aside.
